summary: Badger Meter filed an 8-K reporting an amendment and restatement of its By-laws and the voting results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders. The bylaw amendments cover remote meeting procedures, shareholder list access, expanded disclosures for shareholder proposals and director nominations, updated advance notice deadlines, compliance with Rule 14a-19 for proxy solicitations, and other technical changes. The annual meeting results include election of directors. This is a routine governance update and annual meeting report, not a special situation.
